newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila C. Bank sells dollars at 26.40 pesos.
newsitem.headline: Manila C. Bank sells dollars at 26.40 pesos.

text.p: MANILA, July 9 (Reueter) - The Philippine Central Bank intervened early in the market on Wednesday to sell dollars at 26.40 pesos on renewed market fears of a possible devaluation, traders said.
Volume in less than an hour of trades had already reached $398.65 million.
Investors started to panic after a Singapore newspaper quoted Trade and Industry Secretary Cesar Bautista as saying the issue of devaluation would be taken up during the Monetary Board meeting.
The Philippine peso had been the subject of speculative attacks after last week's de facto devaluation of the Thai baht.
